title: Third-Party Risk Analyst
summary: A third-party risk analyst checks whether the vendors a company works with are safe to trust with its data and systems. They sit in the security or risk team, running security assessments of suppliers, chasing evidence and tracking the risks and gaps they find.
dailyDuties: Run security assessments of new and existing vendors
Send and review questionnaires such as SIG and read SOC reports
Rate inherent and residual risk and record it in a register
Check vendors against ISO 27001, SOC 2 and PCI DSS
Chase remediation evidence and follow up on findings
Brief business owners on vendor risk and sign-off
Track vendors, findings and due dates in spreadsheets

skills.expectation: Run vendor security assessments across the third-party lifecycle
Rate inherent and residual risk and track it in a register
Review vendors against ISO 27001, SOC 2 and PCI DSS
Read SOC reports and SIG questionnaires and spot control gaps
Apply the vendor risk policy and set control requirements
Check vendors handling personal data against the DPDP Act and GDPR
Track vendors, findings and due dates in spreadsheets
Chase evidence from vendors and brief business owners
Apply RBI and SEBI outsourcing expectations in financial services
Assess vendor resilience and recovery plans
